input.question: Which sports team does Yegor Kortsov represent or represent?

documents.text: As the sun dipped into the horizon, casting a warm orange glow over the bustling streets of Piraeus, the air was alive with the hum of anticipation. The locals, clad in their signature blue and white, made their way to the iconic Georgios Karaiskakis Stadium, their hearts beating in unison with the drums of excitement. Tonight, A.S. Pirae, the pride of the port city, would take on their arch-rivals, Olympiacos, in the most highly anticipated match of the season. Among the sea of expectant faces, one figure stood out - Yegor Kortsov, the Russian sensation who had taken the Greek football scene by storm. His piercing blue eyes, chiseled features, and chiseled physique made him an instant fan favorite, but it was his lightning-quick reflexes and uncanny ability to read the game that had earned him a starting spot in A.S. Pirae's lineup. As Yegor made his way to the locker room, he exchanged nods and words of encouragement with his teammates, his thick Russian accent a gentle reminder of his foreign roots. The team's captain, the grizzled veteran Giannis Papadopoulos, clapped him on the back, his eyes gleaming with a mixture of admiration and gratitude. "Tonight, Yegor, we need you to be the difference-maker," he said, his voice low and urgent. Yegor nodded, his mind already focused on the task at hand. He had played in countless high-stakes matches back in Russia, but there was something about the electric atmosphere of the Karaiskakis Stadium that brought out the best in him. As he changed into his kit, the familiar sensation of the A.S. Pirae crest on his chest seemed to imbue him with an extra dose of confidence. The teams took to the field, the roar of the crowd threatening to shake the very foundations of the stadium. Yegor, his eyes locked on the opposing goalkeeper, felt the adrenaline coursing through his veins. This was it - this was what he had been working towards since the day he signed with A.S. Pirae.
